class.name: NNHTNRoot
class.brief_description: Root node that plans and executes a Hierarchical Task Network (HTN).
class.description: Drives a goal-oriented AI planner. Add a top-level [NNHTNCompoundTask] domain under this node whose [NNHTNMethod] children break goals down into primitive [NNHTNTask] steps (and optional [NNHTNParallelTask] groups or reusable [NNHTNSubtaskCall] templates). Use an HTN instead of a behaviour tree when an agent needs to look ahead several steps (for example, realizing it must find a key, unlock a door, and pick up a weapon before attacking) using predicted world-state effects on its [NNBlackboard]. On each tick, the root runs [method on_sense], replans if relevant blackboard keys changed or the current plan finished or failed, and advances the active [NNHTNPlanStep]. Configure search policies and budgets with [member search_settings], and plan switching, hysteresis, or local repair with [member execution_settings]. Like [NNBTRoot] and [NNSTRoot], it ticks automatically according to [member process_thread] and [member tick_rate], can be driven manually with [method tick], or can be hosted inside another AI node.

method.name: are_replan_dependencies_complete
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the last search's replanning dependencies are fully known (not wildcarded by a planning hook without [member NNHTNNodes.dependencies_complete]).

method.name: auto_tick_step
method.description: Runs one scheduled step using the same enabled checks and [member tick_rate] throttle as automatic ticking. Returns [code]true[/code] if the root ticked.

method.name: get_completed_steps
method.description: Returns the steps of the current plan that have already succeeded, in plan order.

method.name: get_current_step
method.description: Returns the currently executing (or next pending) [NNHTNPlanStep], or [code]null[/code] if there is no active plan.

method.name: get_last_cutoff_reason
method.description: Returns a message explaining why the last search stopped early or hit a candidate cap, or an empty string if it completed normally.

method.name: get_last_expansion_count
method.description: Returns the number of expansions used by the last search.

method.name: get_last_repair_result
method.description: Returns a summary dictionary of the most recent local repair attempt ([code]succeeded[/code], [code]attempts[/code], [code]boundary[/code], [code]reason[/code], [code]repaired_count[/code], and [code]suffix_count[/code]), or an empty dictionary if none has occurred.

method.name: get_last_replan_trigger_keys
method.description: Returns the blackboard keys whose changes triggered the last search, or an empty array if triggered by plan completion or [method request_replan].

method.name: get_last_search_result
method.description: Returns metadata for the last search ([code]status[/code], [code]expansions[/code], [code]cost[/code], [code]optimal[/code], [code]utility[/code], [code]cutoff_reason[/code], and [code]trigger_keys[/code]).

method.name: get_last_search_status
method.description: Returns the [enum SearchStatus] of the last search.

method.name: get_last_search_trace
method.description: Returns a copy of the most recent recorded search trace when [member track_search] is enabled, or an empty dictionary otherwise.

method.name: get_plan
method.description: Returns the remaining unfinished steps of the active plan, starting with [method get_current_step].

method.name: get_replan_dependency_keys
method.description: Returns the sorted list of blackboard keys currently watched for automatic replanning.

method.name: get_search_history
method.description: Returns copies of recorded search traces (oldest first) when [member track_search] is enabled. Each dictionary contains search metadata, initial state, plan steps, and decision events.

method.name: on_sense
method.description: Optional hook called at the start of every tick before planning and execution. Override to refresh blackboard world state from the game.

method.name: request_replan
method.description: Schedules a replan on the next tick. Set [param urgent] to [code]true[/code] to bypass hysteresis, [constant NNHTNExecutionSettings.FINISH_CURRENT_STEP], and local repair.

method.name: tick
method.description: Runs one tick: calls [method on_sense], replans if needed, and advances the active plan.

members.member: Optional actor [Node] this planner acts for. When unset, [method NoodleNodes.get_actor] inherits from the nearest ancestor root or falls back to this node's parent.
Optional [NNBlackboard] resource used as world state. When unset, inherits from the nearest ancestor root or creates a private blackboard automatically.
Top-level [NNHTNCompoundTask] to plan from. Leave unset to automatically use the only direct [NNHTNCompoundTask] child.
Optional [NNHTNExecutionSettings] controlling plan interruption, switching hysteresis, and local repair.
Controls when the planner ticks automatically ([constant PHYSICS], [constant IDLE], or [constant MANUAL]). Ignored when hosted under another AI node.
Blackboard keys whose changes should never trigger an automatic replan (for example, continuously changing values like the actor's position).

Optional [NNHTNSearchSettings] configuring search policy ([constant NNHTNSearchSettings.ORDERED], [constant NNHTNSearchSettings.RANKED], or [constant NNHTNSearchSettings.LOWEST_COST]) and search budgets.
Ticks every [code]N[/code]th frame (default [code]1[/code], every frame), passing the accumulated delta since the previous tick. Ignored when hosted under another AI node.

If [code]true[/code], records detailed search traces readable with [method get_search_history] and [method get_last_search_trace]. Leave [code]false[/code] outside debugging to avoid extra memory and copy overhead.

signal.name: effect_commit_failed
signal.description: Emitted when the blackboard schema rejects [param step]'s committed effects, ending the plan.

signal.name: finished
signal.description: Emitted when a run completes ([code]true[/code]) or fails, is invalidated, finds no plan, or has an invalid configuration ([code]false[/code]). Used by hosting nodes.

signal.name: parallel_branch_staged
signal.description: Emitted when a branch of a parallel group finishes and waits for its siblings before committing effects.

signal.name: parallel_group_finished
signal.description: Emitted when a parallel group commits all branches ([code]true[/code]) or fails/is cancelled ([code]false[/code]).

signal.name: parallel_group_started
signal.description: Emitted when execution reaches a concurrent [NNHTNParallelTask] group.

signal.name: plan_finished
signal.description: Emitted when the active plan finishes on its own ([code]true[/code] if all steps succeeded, [code]false[/code] if a step failed or was invalidated).

signal.name: plan_invalidated
signal.description: Emitted when [param step]'s preconditions or object references are no longer valid before ticking, ending the plan.

signal.name: plan_set
signal.description: Emitted when a newly planned sequence of steps is installed.

signal.name: repair_finished
signal.description: Emitted after a local repair attempt finishes.

signal.name: search_finished
signal.description: Emitted after a domain search or successful local repair completes.

signal.name: step_state_changed
signal.description: Emitted when [param step] starts, succeeds, or fails.

signal.name: trace_attempt_recorded
signal.description: Emitted after each search while [member track_search] is enabled.

signal.name: verification_failed
signal.description: Emitted when a step's post-execution verification fails or times out, ending the plan.

signal.name: verification_started
signal.description: Emitted when a [constant NNHTNTask.VERIFY] step finishes executing and begins waiting for postcondition verification.

constants.constant: Ticks automatically on physics frames. This is the default.
Disables automatic ticking so your own code can call [method tick] or [method auto_tick_step].
No valid plan exists for the current world state.
The search stopped early due to a limit in [NNHTNSearchSettings]. Under [constant NNHTNSearchSettings.LOWEST_COST], the cheapest plan found so far may still be returned.
Planning could not run because [member domain], [member search_settings], or [member execution_settings] is missing or invalid.
